title: ggsegAtlasTrack 2.0.0
text: atlastrack rebuilt registered, anatomically-contextualised atlas, now tract atlas (atlas_type() returns "tract") carrying centerline per tract 3D rendering. Tracts now built AtlasTrack’s probabilistic tract maps rather distributed label volume. volume winner-take-projection, every tract dilated far beyond core nested subdivisions cannibalised parents — R_SLF retained 26% high-probability core, rest claimed R_pSLF. Rendering painted whole lobes rather tracts. tract now thresholded 15% maximum probability merged highest-probability-wins, cutting labelled volume roughly four-fold keeping 35 tracts. AtlasTrack lives template space, pitched ~24° fsaverage, previous release rendered tracts spilling outside brain outline. tract cores now affine-registered AtlasTrack T1 — direct intensity T1→T1 alignment fsaverage, rather inferring transform tract extent — resampled fsaverage space. tract reduced principal-curve centerline, drawn 3D tube 2D projection grey fsaverage silhouette. Feeding thresholded cores rather winner-take-volume makes curve fits well conditioned: tract dilated across half lobe meaningful principal axis. 2D projections taken five fixed anatomical positions, specified RAS millimetres rather voxel indices stay correct reference volume changes: axial +17, +2 −11 mm, coronal −17 mm sagittal −12 mm, projected ±8-slice slab. Tracts projections slab; silhouette framing true slice midpoint. sagittal position sits far enough laterally cut cortex gyral ribbon rather tangentially medial wall, staying medial enough retain brainstem corticospinal tract descends (brainstem extend past −17 mm). silhouette includes brainstem, cerebellar cortex deep grey alongside cortical ribbon, tracts leaving cerebrum anatomical context; white matter left unfilled tracts remain visible . aggregate whole-brain fibre masks (AllFib*), fornix-cut labels (Fxcut) empty optic-radiation labels () dropped. CC dropped reason: aggregate rather tract, holding forceps (Fmaj 96%, Fmin 88% inside ) drew fibres twice, sheet rather bundle principal curve wandered diagonally across hemispheres instead following pathway. leaves 34 named tracts. view draws tracts substantially represented , rather every tract happens intersect slab, left panel cluttered tract repeated. Tracts compared per family left right stay together, every tract drawn least one view. Requires ggseg.extra tract-projection orientation, centering, cortex-slice atlas-name fixes; earlier versions mis-place tract projections relative anatomical reference.
